delete.description: Delete one entry from the middle of the log

drop_checkpoint.description: Remove a middle checkpoint from the vault copy

drop_terminal.description: Remove the terminal checkpoint from the vault copy; no anchor retained

duplicate_seq.description: Duplicate one entry so a sequence number repeats

extra_entry_after_terminal.description: an entry appended after the terminal checkpoint

foreign_anchor.description: anchor from a different run supplied

foreign_checkpoint_in_vault.description: terminal checkpoint replaced by the one from a different run (genuinely signed)

forge_signature.description: Corrupt the signature of the terminal checkpoint

modify.description: Change the outcome field of one attack.evaluated entry

other_run_substituted.description: complete log+checkpoints of another run presented as this run

rehash.description: Modify an entry and recompute every later hash (attacker without the signing key)

reorder_checkpoints.description: Swap two adjacent checkpoints in the vault copy

sequence_gap.description: an entry's seq field rewritten and re-hashed

state_mismatch.description: verifier told the run FAILED while evidence says RELEASED

truncate.description: Drop the final entries of the log; the full checkpoint vault is retained

truncate_unprotected.description: Drop the final entries and every checkpoint after freeze; no anchor retained

truncate_vs_anchor.description: Drop the final entries and every checkpoint after freeze; the signed terminal anchor is retained

wrong_event_count.description: reviewer expects a different number of entries

code_revision.note: not a git repository; hash over aegis/ sandbox/ evaluation/ scripts/ tests/ samples/ (*.py, *.sh, *.json)

kind: audit tamper / truncation detection on real released runs
limits: an attacker who rewrites EVERY retained copy (vault, anchor store, reviewer's bundle) and holds the signing key forges a consistent history - not detected
an attacker who controls the verifier or the pinned public key defeats verification
the broker can sign false entries at write time; the chain proves integrity since signing, not truthfulness
30 runs share one synthetic attack pack: the repeats test determinism across signatures, not different workloads
'old_rules_detected' reproduces the 15 Oct 0/30 gap only for the freeze-only retention case

original_gap_case.description: truncate last 3 entries; reviewer retained only the freeze checkpoint (the 0/30 case in the 15 Oct report)
